raw.comments: Repair only `Tablet/FrontTreeOrderedExtension.tex`; preserve its Lean statement, imports, and support structure. After PrefixTree supplies t in F with s an initial segment of t, do not apply Front prefix-freeness to s. Instead use s notin F and t in F to prove s != t, then use the InitialSegment witness to establish that s is a proper initial segment of t, citing the relevant support. In the later density argument, apply prefix-freeness only to pairs actually known to lie in F: handle w=s by s notin F, and if w is a proper prefix of s, use w in F and t in F with w an initial segment of t. Keep the explicit n/witness argument showing v=s union {n} is a PrefixTree node. The current proof's reference to paper lines 1569--1570 should be aligned with the tree argument at lines 1145--1148. Add no helper or structural changes.
